scientific_claim_boundary.not_supported: The three completed registered movable-object center-position reflections support geometry or layout as a major competence confound under this simulator setup. They do not imply that all prompt-conditioned endpoint steering is geometric, identify training-distribution bias as the mechanism, or isolate reachability from other downstream physical mediators. V3-B009 tests an object-role swap, not a full-scene mirror or base rotation, and changes semantics and affordances together. V3-B008 tests target start side without rotating the robot base. An exposed or decoded future also does not establish successful control.
scientific_claim_boundary.supported: Across every completed checkpoint, matched LEFT/RIGHT prompts changed executed traces; endpoint ordering was often aligned, but requested task completion and failure mode remained strongly checkpoint- and direction-dependent. In the separate V3-A002 public old-name-config bridge, all 20 common action prefixes differed and 16/20 endpoints aligned, yet success was 0/20 LEFT versus 12/20 RIGHT. Nano V3-B001, pi0.5 V3-B002, and DreamZero V3-B003 are completed scene-matched positions-only ablations. For pi0.5, reflection left endpoint redirection nearly unchanged (interaction mean -1.12 cm, 95% CI -7.81 to +5.68 cm, sign-test p=0.701) but reversed requested-side depth (interaction mean -34.59 cm, 95% CI -41.38 to -28.46 cm; 27/27 negative, p=1.49e-08) and binary success from control 4/27 LEFT versus 25/27 RIGHT to reflected 25/27 LEFT versus 9/27 RIGHT (mean DiD -1.370, exact p=5.96e-08). DreamZero reflection improved total success from 13/54 to 50/54 and changed depth (interaction mean -14.09 cm, 95% CI -19.92 to -8.19 cm, sign-test p=0.000311), while its binary success-gap DiD was not significant (p=0.581). In V3-D001, pi0.5 succeeded in 41/216 LEFT and 197/216 RIGHT stochastic rollouts; every one of 27 fixed scenes had a positive estimated p(RIGHT)-p(LEFT) gap (mean +0.722, 95% environment-seed cluster-bootstrap CI +0.676 to +0.769, exact sign-test p=1.49e-08).
scientific_claim_boundary.unit_warning: RoboTwin sampling replicates are nested within seven scenes; they are not 63 independent scenes. V3-D001's 432 pi0.5 episodes are eight repeated policy samples nested within 54 fixed scene-direction conditions; the primary inferential unit is the 27 environment seeds.
